The Island Lobster Shirt goes unnamed in {{TWWHD}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{TWW|-}}=== Link's Pajamas are [[Link]]'s default attire in {{TWW}}. Link switches to wearing the [[Hero's Clothes]] after being gifted them by his [[Link's Grandma|Grandma]]. In the [[Second Quest]], Link is instead gifted the invisible [[Hero's New Clothes]], which he wears on top of his Pajamas. This allows Link to instead continue in his adventure with special dialogue addressing Link's blue clothing instead of his standard green. Upon first meeting Link, [[Medli]] will comment on the color of Link's clothing and the "crawfish" design on them. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Descriptions BotW}} The Island Lobster Shirt is a piece of [[Armor]] introduced in [[The Champions' Ballad]] DLC pack as part of the "[[EX Treasure: Garb of Winds]]" [[Side Quest]]. It is a priceless relic that was once kept safely within the walls of [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]], but was later stolen by [[Misko]]. Misko hints at the whereabouts of the Island Lobster Shirt in [[Misko's EX Journal 2]] in the [[Deya Village Ruins]], claiming that it rests at the mouth of the [[Menoat River]]. The [[Treasure Chest]] housing the Island Lobster Shirt can be found in the water beneath the alcove at [[Cora Lake]]. In order to retrieve it, [[Link]] must use the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] to pull it from the water. The Island Lobster Shirt is the same Shirt that Link wore at the beginning of his journey in {{TWW|-}}. When worn, it grants Link with one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. It also grants Link the [[Wake Wind]] [[Added Effect]], allowing him to move a raft with a [[Korok Leaf]] quicker while equipped. If Link sells the Island Lobster Shirt, he can later purchase it from [[Granté]] at [[Tarrey Town]] for 50 [[Rupee]]s. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Descriptions TotK}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{SSBB|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Island Lobster Shirt appears on a [[Trophies in Super Smash Bros. Brawl|Trophy]] of [[Link]] in {{SSBB}}. {{SSBTrophy|SSBB|header=yes}} {{SSBTrophy|SSBB|213|Outset Link|{{TWW}}|Link in his traditional clothing. He wears a blue, V-neck, long-sleeved top with a lobster pattern, coordinated with slender orange pants. It makes you think that, even on his home, [[Outset Island]], Link was quite the fashion leader, and suggests that he may have changed into his green hero's clothing somewhat grudgingly.|Clear {{Ssb|Target Smash}} Level 5 With 10 Characters|altlink=Link}} |} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{HWL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Island Outfits are [[Gold Material]]s which are dropped by [[Toon Link]] in {{HWL}}. They are required to create certain gold [[Badge]]s in the [[Badge Market]] for certain [[Warrior]]s such as [[Medli]] and [[King Daphnes]], and can also be used to make certain [[Mixture]]s in the [[Apothecary]].{{Which}} The Outset Shirt is [[Fairy Clothing]] that [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] can equip in [[My Fairy]]'s [[Salon]]. The Island Outfit also appears as two unnamed [[Costume]]s in {{HWL|-}}. The first is an iteration of the [[Hero's Clothes]] for [[Link]], found on square A12 of the [[Great Sea Map]]. The second is an iteration of Toon Link's Standard Outfit, found on square G4 of the Great Sea Map. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW EX Treasure Garb of Winds.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link equipped with the Island Lobster Shirt File:BotW Island Lobster Shirt Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept art of the Island Lobster Shirt File:HWL Link Great Sea Map Hero's Clothes Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}Link's Island Lobster Shirt-themed Hero's Clothes File:HWDE Toon Link Standard Outfit (Great Sea) Model.png|{{Game Label|{{HWDE|-}}}}Toon Link's Island Lobster Shirt-themed Standard Outfit File:HWL Island Outfit Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}An Island Outfit Material File:HWL Outset Shirt Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}Outset Shirt icon File:HWL Outset Shirt Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{HWL|-}}}}Outset Shirt Salon icon File:HWDE Island Outfit Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWDE|-}}}}An Island Outfit Material File:HWDE Outset Shirt Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{HWDE|-}}}}Outset Shirt icon File:HWDE Outset Shirt Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{HWDE|-}}}}Outset Shirt Salon icon File:TWWHD Club Nintendo Shirt Front.jpg|The front of Club Nintendo reward shirt based on the Island Lobster Shirt File:TWWHD Club Nintendo Shirt Back.jpg|The back of Club Nintendo reward shirt based on the Island Lobster Shirt ==See Also== {{See Also| * Dad's Blue Shirt * EX Treasure: Garb of Winds * Hero's New Clothes * Pirate's Charm * Skyloft Shirt * Toon Link }} {{Ref| {{Cite Guide|TWW BradyGames|page= 158}} {{Cite|Wow!
